description: Election Commission - A. H. A. Lahir was Selected as the member of the Kalmunai Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of the Kalmunai Municipal Council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for replacing a resigned council member, including the nomination by a political party secretary and the formal declaration by the Returning Officer. This content falls squarely within the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authority elections.
